item.title: 5 Verses From the Holy Quran on Love
item.description: "Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allah ] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it" [Quran 3:92].

item.title: Myths, Methods, and Tips on Raising Multi-Lingual Children
item.description: Whatever the method you choose for raising your bilingual children, make sure that they are exposed to the minority language (this being the non-common language in your wider environment) to at least 30% of their time, which roughly means about 25 hours a week.

item.title: Tips for Women to be Ramadan-Ready Without Being Anxious and Overwhelmed
item.description: Besides feeling helpless and physically drained, it is natural for women to feel unhappy due to the fact that they are not always able to find time for ibadah as they want. It can also trigger anxiety and qualms about whether they are a bad Muslim.

item.title: 10 Beautiful Ramadan Traditions From Around the World
item.description: Celebrated by two billion Muslims across the world, here is to this holy and special month!

item.title: 9 Ways To Stay Motivated At Work During Ramadan
item.description: With a handful of alterations to your priorities and behaviours, you can make the most of your month while ensuring productivity at work.

item.title: Mental Health During Ramadan: Heart, Mind, Body and Soul
item.description: One can easily get caught up in comparing oneself to others and feel low about their lack of personal effort or potentially get into the “imposter syndrome” mindset where they feel they are not good rough to be fasting if they have prayed regularly throughout the year, or not wear the hijab, or not as “religious” as Mohammad or Fatima there. item.title: 10 Beautiful Eid Al-Fitr Celebrations From Around the World
item.description: As the beautiful month of Ramadan comes to an end, here are just a few of the ways Muslims around the world celebrate Eid al-Fitr!

item.title: Post-Ramadan Blues and Fighting Negative Self-Talk
item.description: We should try out best to do something a little extra every night before we go to bed insha’Allah. If it’s a little dhikr, recitation, or prayer, may Allah accept it from us, and who knows we may find Laylat al-Qadr far outside of Ramadan.

item.title: Why We Need More Minimalist Muslims
item.description: It may be difficult to say no to the latest trend, to resist that late-night purchase, but imagine that we diverted just one-third of our usual material expenditure to the way of Allah (swt). What if we asked for donations to our favourite charity, instead of a mountain of gifts?
